source_clauses: release exactly one each time I press a lever, so I never get two at once
refill it from the top without taking it off the wall
must not jam when it is nearly empty

requirements.statement: The dispenser must hold approximately twenty small items.
The dispenser must release exactly one item each time a lever is pressed, ensuring that two items are never released at once.
The dispenser must be refillable from the top without being removed from the wall.
The dispenser must not jam when it is nearly empty.

scenarios.description: User presses a lever to release exactly one item.
User refills the dispenser from the top without removing it from the wall.

freedoms: The mechanism for releasing items is not specified.
The material of the dispenser is not specified.
The dimensions of the dispenser are not specified.
The method of wall mounting is not specified.
The type of small items is not specified.
ambiguities: What is the tolerance for 'exactly one'?
What is the meaning of 'nearly empty'?
How should the dispenser behave when the user presses the lever multiple times quickly?
Is the release mechanism required to be a lever, or is it just an example?
assumptions: The dispenser is for small items that are uniform in size and shape.
The lever is manually operated by the user.
The dispenser is intended for indoor use.
